name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 55 - Am 142
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 55 a. Calls for the resources of the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund (AMIF) to be refocused on the effective management of migration flows, in particular the fight against illegal immigration; stresses that the AMIF must put an end to incentives for immigration and, conversely, contribute to strengthening the external dimension of migration policies by developing enhanced cooperation with third countries, thereby ensuring the effectiveness of return and readmission decisions;
